articles.company_name: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust Common Shares of Beneficial Interest
articles.summary: PennyMac Mortgage Investment Trust (NYSE: PMT) today reported net income attributable to common shareholders of $41.9 million, or $0.48 per common share for the fourth quarter of 2025, on net investment income of $93.6 million. PMT previously announced a cash dividend for the fourth quarter of 2025 of $0.40 per common share of beneficial interest, which was declared on December 10, 2025, and will be paid on January 23, 2026, to common shareholders of record as of December 26, 2025.
